CITY OF ALHAMBRA PLANNING COMMISSION
  ACTION MINUTES

  Regular Meeting
  October 20, 2025

A.  CALL MEETING TO ORDER:  7:02 P.M. in the Council Chambers of Alhambra City Hall,
  and via video conference and teleconference.

B.  ROLL CALL:

  Present:  Dorado, Grijalva, Ho, Juarez, Mojarro, Olson

  Absent:  Chen, Gardea, Garcia

  Staff Present: Maia McCurley, Planning Manager; Megan Wu, Senior Planner; Karabeth
  Garcia, Executive Assistant; Erica Vega, Deputy City Attorney

C.  FLAG SALUTE:  Led by President Olson

D.  CONSENT AGENDA:

  AGENDA
  ITEM 1:  MINUTES – AUGUST 18, 2025
  • Request: This is a request for the Planning Commission to
  approve the Minutes of the August 18, 2025, Regular Meeting of
  the Alhambra Planning Commission.
  • Recommended Action: Commission review and approve as
  submitted the Minutes of the August 18, 2025, Regular Meeting of
  the Alhambra Planning Commission.

  AGENDA
  ITEM 2:  MINUTES – OCTOBER 4, 2021
  • Request: This is a request for the Planning Commission to
  approve the Minutes of the October 4, 2021, Regular Meeting of
  the Alhambra Planning Commission.
  • Recommended Action: Commission review and approve as
  submitted the Minutes of the October 4, 2021, Regular Meeting of
  the Alhambra Planning Commission.

  AGENDA
  ITEM 3:  MINUTES – SEPTEMBER 20, 2021
  • Request: This is a request for the Planning Commission to
  approve the Minutes of the September 20, 2021, Regular Meeting
  of the Alhambra Planning Commission.
  • Recommended Action: Commission review and approve as
  submitted the Minutes of the September 20, 2021, Regular
  Meeting of the Alhambra Planning Commission.

  MOTION:
  •  Moved to approve Consent Agenda Items 1, 2, and 3.

  1
  10/20/2025
   •  Moved by Commissioner Ho, Seconded by Commissioner Dorado.
  •  The motion carried by the following roll call vote:

  Roll Call Vote: 6-0-0-3
  Ayes:  Dorado, Grijalva, Ho, Juarez, Mojarro, Olson
  Noes:  None
  Abstain: None
  Absent:  Chen, Gardea, Garcia

E.  DISCUSSION ITEMS

  •  There were no discussion items.

F.  PUBLIC HEARINGS:

  AGENDA
  ITEM 4:  PLANNED DEVELOPMENT PERMIT PD-24-03
  • 105 North Second Street
  • Applicant: Phillip Chan
  • This is an application for a Planned Development Permit PD-24-
  03 to allow for the demolition of an existing single-family residence
  and the construction of a 6-unit apartment complex, located at 105
  North Second Street within the RH (Residential High Density)
  zone.
  • Recommended Action: Adopt Resolution No. 25-09, approving
  Planned Development Permit PD-24-03, to allow for the
  demolition of an existing single-family residence and the
  construction of a 6-unit apartment complex, located at 105 North
  Second Street within the RH (Residential High Density) zone, and
  finding Planned Development Permit PD-24-03 to be exempt from
  review under the California Environmental Quality Act (CEQA)
  pursuant to Section 15332 of the CEQA Guidelines, In-fill
  Developments.
  • Senior Planner Megan Wu provided the Staff presentation.
  • Phillip Chan, the Applicant, and Gino Yu, Property Owner, were
  available to answer questions.
  • The public hearing was opened and then closed.
  • Public Comments:
  1.) David Pau
  2.) Raul Basco
  3.) Laurence Wang
  4.) Alborz Mohtashami
  5.) Lewis McCammon
  6.) Elliott Lee

  MOTION:
  •  Moved to approve Agenda Item 4.
  •  Moved by Commissioner Ho, Seconded by Commissioner Dorado.
  •  The motion carried by the following roll call vote:

  Roll Call Vote: 6-0-0-3
  Ayes:  Dorado, Grijalva, Ho, Juarez, Mojarro, Olson
  2
  10/20/2025
   Noes:  None
  Abstain:  None
  Absent:  Chen, Gardea, Garcia

G.  ORAL COMMUNICATIONS:

  •  There were no Oral Communications.

H.  COMMENTS FROM THE PLANNING COMMISSION AND CONFERENCE/MEETING
  REPORTS:

  •  President Olson announced the Alhambra Historical Society is having a free and
  open to the public event on November 6th at 7:00 p.m. at the Alhambra Masonic
  Center. Speaker Tim Gregory, a building a biographer from Pasadena, will present
  on how to research the history on your house or property.

I.  COMMENTS FROM STAFF:

  •  There were no comments from Staff.

J.  ADJOURNMENT:

  •  There being no other business, the meeting was adjourned at 8:18 P.M. to Monday,
  November 3, 2025, at 7:00 P.M.

  _____________________________
  Chris Olson
  President
ATTEST:

_______________________
Karabeth Garcia
Executive Assistant
